text: 今年1—7月份，全国社会物流总额214.5万亿元，同比增长5.0%。社会物流总额保持稳定增长，需求结构有所优化。工业品物流基本盘稳定，结构升级态势愈发明显。1—7月份，工业品物流总额同比增长5.3%。其中，传统采矿类物流需求偏弱，而制造业物流仍为增长核心引擎。7月份制造业相关物流需求同比增长5.5%，增速较全部工业品物流高出1个百分点。其中，装备制造物流需求同比增长12.3%，高技术制造相关物流需求增长16.9%。
text_en: From January to July this year, China's total social logistics value reached 214.5 trillion yuan, up 5.0% year on year. Total logistics value maintained steady growth with some optimization in demand structure. Industrial goods logistics remained stable, with an increasingly clear trend of structural upgrading. From January to July, industrial goods logistics value rose 5.3% year on year. Among this, traditional mining logistics demand was soft, while manufacturing logistics remained the core growth engine. In July, manufacturing-related logistics demand grew 5.5% year on year, 1 percentage point higher than the growth for all industrial goods. Equipment manufacturing logistics demand rose 12.3%, and high-tech manufacturing-related logistics demand grew 16.9%.
